exposure: prenatal exposure to parabens (methylparaben, ethylparaben, propylparaben)
cohort: 154 pregnant women living in Algiers, from whom umbilical cord venous blood samples were taken immediately after delivery.
finding: Prenatal exposure to ethylparaben was associated with increased TSH and decreased FT3, while propylparaben exposure was linked to decreased TSH and FT4; paraben levels also showed significant associations with newborn gestational age, birth weight, and anogenital distance in male newborns.
cross-section timing: Umbilical cord venous blood samples were taken immediately after delivery.
